description: This file is a Makefile fragment for configuring, checking, and building BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) programs within a larger software project, specifically related to OpenWRT and Linux kernel headers. It defines variables, conditional logic for toolchain detection, compiler flags, and a macro for compiling BPF programs.

methods.name: CompileBPF
methods.description: A macro that compiles a BPF source file into an object file, performs LLVM optimization, disassembly, assembly, and stripping for debugging purposes.
